# token-var-name

`tokenVarName(key)`: the CSS custom property a token-group schema key paints,
as a leaf with no imports. It lives apart from `theme-engine/core` so a static
reader of token groups (`plugin-meta/token-usage`, run by the cross-refs facet)
spells vars exactly as `defineTokenGroup` does without loading the theme
engine: a plugin record's key follows the whole closure of every barrel its
producer imports, and the theme-engine barrel reaches config_v2, network/live
and the field registry (188 modules).
